retrieval_summary: Preserve unrounded joint residuals and original evaluator thresholds before considering finite continuation.
trigger: Preserve unrounded joint residuals and original evaluator thresholds before considering finite continuation.
procedure: A tiny positive residual is still failure; a display rounded to the threshold is not evidence of acceptance.
Check units, complete coverage, source identity and every predicate. Joint position/axis or position/speed tasks cannot be reduced to one passing component.
M2 retained a holding-speed excess of about 8.96e-16 m/s. Same-candidate continuation with an internal search margin then required a new independent replay; it did not relax acceptance.
BF5 continuation was separately authorized. BF6 R7 is a counterexample to equating near-threshold improvement with success; retain its STOP and spent budget.

applicability: Finite continuation may stagnate or worsen; directed axis does not establish full orientation, robustness or physical feasibility outside the tested model.
escalation: Obtain current scoped evidence and separate action authorization; retain original evaluator and budgets.
